tasks.title: Initialize project skeleton with TypeScript toolchain and dependencies
tasks.description: Create the LearnLoop project structure with TypeScript/Node.js build configuration, install core dependencies (better-sqlite3, minisearch), set up test runner, and establish the module directory layout. The project must build and pass an empty test suite upon completion.
acceptance_criteria: Running the build command produces valid JavaScript output with no errors
TypeScript strict mode is enabled in tsconfig.json
better-sqlite3 is listed as a production dependency and can be imported without error
minisearch is listed as a production dependency and can be imported without error
A test runner (vitest or jest) is configured and executing the test command exits with code 0
Source directories exist: src/storage/, src/search/, src/memory/, src/reflection/, src/hooks/, src/llm/, src/config/, src/types/
Test directory exists: test/fixtures/
The database directory path defaults to ~/.openclaw/learnloop/ when resolved from configuration

bdd_scenarios.name: Project builds and tests pass on clean checkout
given: A fresh clone of the repository with dependencies installed
bdd_scenarios.when: The build command is executed followed by the test command
then: Both commands exit with code 0
No TypeScript compilation errors are emitted

tasks.title: Implement SQLite storage layer with schema initialization and CRUD for memories, reflections, and session states
tasks.description: Implement the SQLite storage engine that auto-creates the database file and directory on first access, initializes all three tables (memories, reflections, session_states) with correct schemas and indexes, and provides CRUD operations for each entity. All data is stored locally at ~/.openclaw/learnloop/learnloop.db using raw SQL via better-sqlite3.
acceptance_criteria: When the database file does not exist, calling the storage initialization creates ~/.openclaw/learnloop/learnloop.db automatically
When the directory ~/.openclaw/learnloop/ does not exist, it is created recursively before database creation

The memories table contains columns: id (TEXT PK), type (TEXT NOT NULL), content (TEXT NOT NULL), subject (TEXT NOT NULL), confidence (REAL NOT NULL default 0.5), importance (REAL NOT NULL default 0.5), source_session (TEXT NOT NULL), access_count (INTEGER NOT NULL default 0), last_accessed_at (TEXT), created_at (TEXT NOT NULL), updated_at (TEXT NOT NULL)

The reflections table contains columns: id (TEXT PK), task_type (TEXT NOT NULL), task_summary (TEXT NOT NULL), outcome (TEXT NOT NULL), signals (TEXT NOT NULL), reflection (TEXT NOT NULL), lessons (TEXT NOT NULL), agent_id (TEXT), source_session (TEXT), created_at (TEXT NOT NULL)
The session_states table contains columns: session_key (TEXT PK), extracted (INTEGER NOT NULL default 0), conversation_hash (TEXT), created_at (TEXT NOT NULL), updated_at (TEXT NOT NULL)
Inserting a memory record and reading it back returns all fields with identical values
Updating an existing memory's content and confidence changes those fields and updates updated_at, while preserving other fields
Inserting a reflection record and reading it back returns all fields with identical values, with signals and lessons stored as JSON strings
Inserting a session_state record, updating its extracted flag to 1, and reading it back reflects the updated value
Querying memories by subject returns only records matching that subject
Querying memories by type returns only records matching that type
Deleting a memory by id removes it and subsequent read returns null/undefined

bdd_scenarios.name: Database auto-creates on first write
given: No database file exists at the configured path
bdd_scenarios.when: A memory record is inserted via the storage layer
then: The database file exists at the configured path
The inserted record can be read back successfully

bdd_scenarios.name: Memory CRUD round-trip
given: An initialized database with an empty memories table
bdd_scenarios.when: A memory is inserted, read, updated, and deleted in sequence
then: Each operation returns the expected result
After deletion the memory is no longer retrievable

bdd_scenarios.name: Reflection insert and retrieval
given: An initialized database with an empty reflections table
bdd_scenarios.when: A reflection with signals=['user_feedback:positive'] and lessons=['check dependencies'] is inserted
then: Reading it back returns signals and lessons as parseable JSON arrays with the original values

scope: Schema DDL for all three tables
CRUD operations for memories, reflections, and session_states

tasks.title: Integrate MiniSearch BM25 engine with storage layer for text search on memories and reflections
tasks.description: Integrate minisearch as the BM25 text search engine, indexing memory content/subject and reflection task_summary/reflection fields. The search index must be built from existing database records on initialization and kept in sync when records are added or updated. Search must support CJK text and return results within the latency constraint.
acceptance_criteria: After initializing the search engine with 100 memory records, searching by a keyword present in one record's content returns that record's id in the results
After adding a new memory record via the storage layer, searching for a unique term in that record's content returns it without requiring a full re-index
After updating a memory record's content, searching for the old unique term no longer returns that record, and searching for the new term does
After deleting a memory record, searching for its unique content term no longer returns that record
Searching for a Chinese term (e.g., '偏好') that exists in a memory's content returns that memory in results
Searching reflections by a keyword in task_summary returns matching reflection ids
Search returns results scored by BM25 relevance (highest relevance first)
Searching across 1000 indexed memory records completes in under 100ms
Searching with a query that matches no records returns an empty result set
The search index is rebuilt from database contents when the storage module initializes

bdd_scenarios.name: BM25 search returns relevant memories
given: 10 memory records exist with varied content including one containing '用户偏好中文沟通'
bdd_scenarios.when: A search is performed with query '中文沟通'
then: The result set includes the memory containing '用户偏好中文沟通'
The result set is non-empty and ordered by relevance

bdd_scenarios.name: Search latency within budget for 1000 records
then: The search completes and returns results in under 100ms

bdd_scenarios.name: Index stays in sync after record mutation
given: A memory with content 'deploy script fix' is indexed
bdd_scenarios.when: The memory content is updated to 'CI pipeline optimization' and a search for 'deploy script' is performed
then: The search for 'deploy script' returns an empty result
A search for 'pipeline optimization' returns the updated memory

tasks.title: 验证存储层 CRUD 操作与数据库自动创建
tasks.description: 验证 SQLite 存储层对 memories、reflections、session_states 三张表的完整 CRUD 操作正确性，以及数据库文件不存在时自动创建的行为。此任务为 verify 角色，假设存储层实现已由同 phase 的 sibling tasks 完成，本任务聚焦于黑盒行为验证。
acceptance_criteria: 向 memories 表插入一条完整记录后，按 id 查询返回的记录各字段值与插入时一致
向 memories 表插入记录后，通过 update 修改 content 和 confidence 字段，再次查询返回更新后的值
向 reflections 表插入一条完整记录后，按 id 查询返回的记录各字段值与插入时一致
向 reflections 表插入记录后，通过 update 修改 reflection 和 outcome 字段，再次查询返回更新后的值
向 session_states 表插入一条记录后，按 id 查询返回的记录各字段值与插入时一致
删除 memories 表中的一条记录后，按该 id 查询返回 null 或 undefined
删除 reflections 表中的一条记录后，按该 id 查询返回 null 或 undefined
当数据库文件路径不存在时，首次执行写入操作后数据库文件被自动创建且包含 memories、reflections、session_states 三张表
memories 表的 type 字段仅接受 preference、fact、entity、episode 四种值之一，插入其他值时操作失败或被拒绝
reflections 表的 outcome 字段仅接受 success、failure、partial 三种值之一，插入其他值时操作失败或被拒绝
memories 表中 confidence 和 importance 字段未指定时使用默认值 0.5，access_count 默认值为 0

bdd_scenarios.name: 数据库文件不存在时自动创建
given: 指定的数据库文件路径不存在
bdd_scenarios.when: 初始化存储层并执行一次写入操作
then: 数据库文件在指定路径被创建
查询 sqlite_master 返回 memories、reflections、session_states 三张表

tasks.title: 验证 BM25 搜索正确性与检索延迟约束
tasks.description: 验证基于 minisearch 的 BM25 文本搜索在 memories 和 reflections 数据上的搜索正确性，包括中英文内容的匹配、相关性排序，以及在 1000 条数据规模下检索延迟 < 100ms 的性能约束。
acceptance_criteria: 向 memories 表插入 5 条不同 content 的记录后，搜索其中一条的关键词返回该条记录在结果列表中
搜索一个不存在于任何记录中的关键词，返回空结果列表
向 memories 表插入包含中文 content 的记录后，使用中文关键词搜索能匹配到该记录
搜索结果按 BM25 相关性评分降序排列（评分最高的排在第一位）
向 reflections 表插入 5 条不同 task_summary 的记录后，按 task_summary 关键词搜索返回匹配的记录
在 memories 表中插入 1000 条记录后，单次搜索操作耗时 < 100ms
在 reflections 表中插入 1000 条记录后，单次搜索操作耗时 < 100ms
部分匹配场景：搜索词为记录 content 的子串时，能返回包含该子串的记录
